name: Watchlist
description: Watchlist treats each user's Jellyfin Favorites as their watchlist. When a favorited movie is marked played, or a favorited series reaches the configured completion rule, the plugin removes it from that user's Favorites. The plugin works with the native star button and Favorites page on every Jellyfin client.
overview: Use Jellyfin Favorites as a watchlist and remove completed movies and series.

versions.changelog: 0.2.3: Fixed series tracking dropped after a library scan adds new episodes (stale cached IsFavorite verified against the fresh favorites listing) and refresh baselines automatically when library items are added, updated, or removed. Hardened the Playwright getItem helper against the same stale single-item endpoint. 0.2.2: Fixed the reconciliation setting being ignored by the cleanup task, rating/favorite events re-arming removal or shrinking baselines, series rule changes wiping movie tracking, announced future seasons falling back to older ones, and favorite-then-play races for movies. Batched event handling with a single state save and per-series episode collapsing. 0.2.1: Hardened baselines against library churn (content fingerprint, no shrink-as-completion), latest-season unaired handling, dry-run and toggle safety, stale config/event guards, state preservation, and manual scan bypass. 0.2.0: Consolidated Favorites-based watchlist. No playlist support. 0.1.0: Initial release.
